result.summary: The application interface is generally well-structured; however, there is a minor visual issue related to content cropping within the promotional image.

issues.description: The bottom promotional card (showing a pizza) is cut off vertically, preventing the user from seeing the full image or context of the advertisement.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or margins of the bottom section or resize the image asset to ensure it fits better within the visible viewport without being awkwardly clipped.
